content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the klaipeda district court the court ordered defendant 2 to pay €152 in legal fees in the final resolution the court awarded the applicant identified as km €2300 as compensation for the sale of a vehicle registered under their name the court also awarded the defendant identified as vm another vehicle valued at €30000 the case involved three articles from the civil code guaranteeing the rights of creditors determining the value of assets and joint matrimonial property km requested the annulment of their marriage with vm due to fault on both sides the court must decide on the division of property and whether it is community or separate property km was ordered to pay the costs of the proceedings amounting to €152
